npcs.name: Edda the Guide
lines: Welcome to Oakcross, the main town of the Heartlands! The stone bank is northwest, the town hall is north, and the inn is southeast.
Visit the market in the square, the forge to the east, or the chapel in the southwest. The northern armory has equipment for new adventurers.

npcs.name: Sir Rowan
lines: I patrol the eastern gate and keep the roads safe.
Keep your blade ready beyond the village.

npcs.name: Mira the Herbalist
lines: Welcome to my herb stall. Fresh greens and remedies from the forest.
The forests are alive with useful plants.

npcs.name: Bram the Woodsman
lines: I collect timber beside Northwatch, not in the middle of town.
The tall pines make fine beams.

npcs.name: Lysa the Scout
lines: I keep watch over Eastmarch and its roads.
The eastern roads wind toward Suncrest.

npcs.name: Torren the Smith
lines: Welcome to the Ember Forge. These stone walls keep the heat in while I work.
I keep blades and tools ready for travelers. Bring me ore when smithing is available.

npcs.name: Fen the Ranger
lines: I patrol Westmere and watch the forest trails.
Keep your eyes open for landmarks.

npcs.name: Nara the Wanderer
lines: I am resting near Suncrest before my next journey.
The western ruins are older than the kingdoms themselves.

npcs.name: Garrick the Banker
lines: Welcome to Oakcross Bank. Your valuables deserve a safe place.
You will find the tellers in this hall and the iron vault at the back. Personal storage is not available yet.

npcs.name: Pella the Merchant
lines: Welcome to my market stall! Look at the goods on my table.
Travelers always need provisions for the road.

npcs.name: Alda the Innkeeper
lines: Welcome to the Stag & Lantern! Take a seat by the tables and rest your feet.
Oakcross is the main town of the Heartlands. Everyone passes through our square sooner or later.

npcs.name: Steward Elian
lines: Welcome to Oakcross Town Hall. Our town links the roads of the Heartlands.
The bank, chapel, forge, market and inn all serve the folk who call this place home.

npcs.name: Sister Maeve
lines: Peace to you, traveler. The Chapel of the Dawn is open to all.
You may rest among the pews before returning to the roads.

npcs.name: Hobb the Sweeper
lines: A good day for street sweeper. There is always work to do around here.
The roads bring new faces to our town every day.
